about: The global executor set: invented tasks in invented worlds, each with the behaviour that holds for anyone: hand back when a document is locked, read before drafting, don't guess between two people, don't ask when the answer is in front of you. Turned from spot checks into invented cases by hand. Committed to a public repo, so nothing here may come from a real message. Each case has its own "now" (a Tuesday in October 2026), so its dates never fall in the past whatever day the eval runs.

cases.name: locked-doc-hands-back
cases.why: The document it needs is locked: it asks for access or hands back, and never drafts a summary it couldn't read

task.title: Summarise the Orbit pricing doc for Sam

mail.subject: Orbit pricing
mail.text: Can you give me the short version of the Orbit pricing doc before Thursday?

cases.name: reads-before-drafting
cases.why: The time of the review is in the invite: it looks before it drafts, and puts that time in the reply

task.title: Reply to Marco confirming the design review

mail.subject: Design review
mail.text: Can you make the design review? Let me know and I'll send the deck.

cases.name: two-danas-asks-which
cases.why: Two people could be the one it's for, and nothing tells them apart: it asks rather than guessing

mail.subject: Lunch Friday?
mail.text: Are we still on for lunch Friday?

cases.name: answer-in-front-drafts
cases.why: The answer is in the person's own mail: it drafts with it instead of asking them
